deviations.justification: TRD-031 replaces `bv --robot-plan/--robot-insights/--robot-triage` with optional work-graph.plan and work-graph.graph-health; there is no triage capability and its summary folds into graph-health findings.

Reads of repository state (current branch, default branch, repo toplevel, remote URL, branch existence) are reworded to state their intent without a literal git command because no workflow.* capability exposes them; for the backend/remote the TRD-039 resolver detection (`toolchain-cli explain`/`resolve`) is the source.

Reads of repository state (current branch, default branch, repo toplevel, remote URL, branch existence) are reworded to state their intent without a literal git command because no workflow.* capability exposes them; for the backend/remote the TRD-039 resolver detection (`toolchain-cli explain`/`resolve`) is the source.

No workflow.* capability stages files (plain-git workflow.commit is `git commit -m` only), so the source now states the staging intent ("stage exactly that path") without a literal `git add`; the agent still stages the same explicit paths before workflow.commit.

The pre-refactor phase test step delegated to @test-runner with no literal command; TRD-045 makes it `toolchain-cli run test-runner.run`, whose default adapter template is `node packages/jest/skills/jest/run-test.js` (the per-language runner script the agent resolved before).

The pre-refactor `npm run test` full-suite gate was inlined in the workflow steps; the refactor defines it once as FULL_TEST_COMMAND (package-runner.run-script, default `npm run`) in the mission block that follows the workflow steps, and the gate steps reference the variable. The gate is performed at the same workflow points.
